newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid bourse trudges into close holding gains.
newsitem.headline: Madrid bourse trudges into close holding gains.

text.p: The Madrid bourse trudged into the close on Tuesday with early session gains held tightly under its belt. Dealers said trade had been scarce and buying selective.

The general index rose 2.53 points, 0.42 percent, to 597.99, while the Ibex-35 index of leading shares climbed 35.74 points, 0.53 percent, to 6,817.90. Turnover was thin with just 45.8 billion pesetas changing hands.
"Volume is scarce, the market is dominated by professionals, but I think the tone in the market is better and there isn't the fear that characterised the market 10 days ago," said one dealer.
Telefonica was the focus for trade for much of the session and ended 10 pesetas up at 4,150. Repsol, another blue chip attracting selective buyers, ended 40 pesetas up at 6,260.
Endesa outperformed the market, rising 2.18 percent to 3,275 pesetas. "The future privatisation is continuing to boost the stock," one trader said.
